messages:
Ravi Malhotra: Heads up - Myriad Accelerate asks for a custom term: they missed ~45% of their committed inference hours in Q1 due to a cloud peering outage at their end. Sales requests: partial credit + a promotional rate for next 2 invoices to smooth adoption. Need Deal Desk ok by EOD.

Priya Singh: Quick numbers from Sales: quarterly reserved hours = 9,000 GPU-hours, billed monthly (3,000/mo). March actual effective usage ~1,650. Proposal from Sales: credit 1,350 hours pro-rated at $0.30/hr = $405, plus a 20% discount on overage billed hours for the next 2 invoices.

Maya Chen: My threshold: I can approve up to $5k credit. This looks small but we need Legal addendum and explicit customer acceptance. Also please confirm whether this will be applied as a credit memo or invoice adjustment.

Oliver (Accounting): For audit, create a credit memo (CM-MA-0316), GL 4-210-credits. Note must say "one-time operational concession". If we apply discount, tag it in billing system and capture dates.

Ravi Malhotra: Sales says low churn risk and high chance to expand usage next quarter. They also asked that the discount stack with early-adopter promo — we should disallow stacking per policy.

Ava (Legal): Draft clause: "Redwood Inference will issue a one-time credit memo in the amount of $405 applied to invoice MA-2026-03. Customer will receive a 20% discount on billed overage charges for the two subsequent billing cycles (April 2026 and May 2026). This concession is a one-time goodwill allowance, does not amend the underlying commitment, is non-transferable, and does not stack with other promotions. Customer must acknowledge acceptance by replying to the Redwood contact email within 7 business days."

Maya Chen: OK I approve the $405 credit memo and 20% overage discount for two cycles, conditioned on Legal addendum and customer ack. Oliver - create CM, mark GL 4-210-credits, and open a ticket.

Oliver (Accounting): Creating CM-MA-0316 and ticket FIN-4357. Scheduling application for next billing run pending customer ack. finance-bot created FIN-4357

finance-bot: Ticket FIN-4357 created by Oliver (Accounting) - Credit memo CM-MA-0316 $405 for MA-2026-03, GL 4-210-credits. Addendum requested: 20% overage discount for Apr+May 2026 pending customer ack.

Priya Singh: I'll send addendum and capture acceptance. Sales will also document expected expansion in Q3 in the CRM for escalation if needed.

Ravi Malhotra: Thanks — record as one-off in concessions register and flag if we see repeat requests from same cohort.

Maya Chen: Closing: Approved, CM and ticket created, Legal addendum required, customer acceptance email required. Tagging under Q1 concessions. :white_check_mark:
